domain_hint: Cleanroom diffuser layout CFD with RANS in Ansys Fluent and probe-based validation
ambiguity_notes:
- Numerics inconsistency: slides claim second-order/QUICK and SST k-ω, but production runs used first-order upwind and realizable k-ε with wall functions.
- Near-wall resolution contradiction: intent stated y+ < 1, yet reported y+ ≈ 28–45 in production runs.
- Operating point mismatch: total supply documented as 1.20 kg/s in slides vs 1.00 kg/s in validation run; inlet turbulence intensity assumed 5% while AHU indicates 1–2%.
- Validation statistics conflict: summary reports 6% MAE after excluding outliers; detailed log shows 11.8% MAE including all probes.
- UQ claims vs execution: stated 300-sample LHS with >90% coverage; repository shows 30 runs (28 usable) and recalculated coverage ~72%.
